description: React component for visualizing interoperability mappings with graph and table, including data extraction, mock data fallback, and interactive selection.

methods.name: safeArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array; returns empty array if not.

methods.name: clipText
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: normalizeConfidence
methods.description: Converts confidence indicators (string or number) to 'High', 'Medium', or 'Low'.

methods.name: confidenceColor
methods.description: Returns color code based on confidence level.

methods.name: confidencePillStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for confidence badge based on confidence level.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects the first non-null value from an object based on provided keys.

methods.name: toMappingRow
methods.description: Converts raw object to a standardized MappingRow if possible.

methods.name: buildRobustMockMappings
methods.description: Creates mock mapping data for fallback visualization.

methods.name: buildMappingsFromAppState
methods.description: Extracts mapping data from various possible backend data shapes or heuristics.

methods.name: uniqueBy
methods.description: Filters array to unique items based on a key function.

methods.name: buildTwoColumnGraph
methods.description: Arranges mappings into a two-column graph layout with nodes and edges.

methods.name: SvgGraph
methods.description: React component rendering the SVG graph visualization of mappings.

methods.name: InteroperabilityMapPage
methods.description: Main React component for the interoperability map page, managing state, data processing, and rendering visualization and details.
